Calendar of Wills and Administrations 1918, page 208 — Gleeson entries (and adjacent Glasgo/Gleasure/Gledstanes for page context).

## Family relevance

**STRONGEST UPGRADE CANDIDATE for the Naas 1888 Michael Gleeson lead** (see `gleeson-naas-1888-michael-lead` memory):

> **Gleeson, Patrick.** Munnia, Killoscully, Newport, Co. Tipperary, **Labourer**. Limerick D.R. Will. Grant – 11 March, 1918. Execix. – **Honora Gleeson, widow.**

This documents a Patrick + Honora Gleeson couple in Tipperary, dying March 1918. The 1888 Naas marriage record named Michael Gleeson's parents as "Patk Gleeson + Honora O'Brien of Tipperary" — same couple structure, same county. If confirmed as the same family, this would upgrade the Naas 1888 lead from T3 → T2 and supports the scenario where the 1829 Patrick (our Patrick's older brother) survived as a Tipperary-resident Labourer.

**Caveat:** Newport, Co. Tipperary is in **Killaloe diocese**, not Cashel & Emly (our family's diocese). That's a real diocese-boundary move from Hospital parish if this is our 1829 Patrick. Possible but lowers the prior modestly.

**Other Newport-area Gleesons on this page** (potential extended kin):
- Gleeson, John — Verryleigh, Newport, Co. Tipperary
- Gleeson, Patrick — Ballynavoneen, Glenculloo, Newport, Co. Tipperary, Farmer, widow Catherine

**Upgrade paths from here:**
1. Pull the actual probate document for Killoscully Patrick to see if Honora's maiden name is recorded
2. Search Tipperary baptisms 1858-1866 for Michael Gleeson son of Patrick Gleeson Labourer + Honora O'Brien at Killoscully/Munnia
3. Search Tipperary marriage records for Patrick Gleeson m. Honora O'Brien c. 1850-1865 in Newport-area parishes

**Gleeson, Patrick.** Munnia, Killoscully, Newport, Co. Tipperary, Labourer. Limerick D.R. Will. Grant – 11 March, 1918. Execix. – Honora Gleeson, widow. ← **OUR INTEREST**

**Gleeson, Patrick.** Ballynavoneen, Glenculloo, Newport, Co. Tippy, Farmer. Limerick D.R. Admon. 23 Decer. 1918. Admix. – Cathre. Gleeson.

*Note: In these historical Irish probate indices, **P.R.** stands for Principal Registry, **D.R.** stands for District Registry, **Admon.** refers to Administration (where no will was left or proved), and abbreviations like **Excor/Execix** and **Admor/Admix** refer to the Executor/Executrix and Administrator/Administratrix of the estate.*
